text:
maria_cs_ops: Heads-up: we're getting a spike of false 'at-risk' markings tied to onboarding event duplication. I paused the auto-nudge playbook for new cohorts (48h) to avoid noisy emails.

anya_data: digging in now. The ingestion pipeline shows a 40m consumer lag on cs-onboard, during which duplicate first_success events were emitted. Likely cause: consumer restart + rebalancing.

sam_sre: confirmed. consumer lag hit ~110k msgs from 02:05-02:45 UTC, then consumer restarted and caught up. logs: 
```
[02:44:58] WARN cs-onboard-consumer: partition 3 lag=108321
[02:45:12] INFO restarting consumer
[02:46:01] INFO lag drained
```

devon_cs: any customers already nudged? we need to avoid confusing outreach.

anya_data: a small batch (~2.1k accounts) received outbound events during the window. I'll export the list and drop CSV in #cs-ops-asana. SQL used: SELECT account_id, email, sent_at FROM outbound_events WHERE event_type='onboard_nudge' AND sent_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1826002600) AND to_timestamp(1826004400);

product_lucas: short-term mitigation: add a debounce in scoring to ignore state flips shorter than 10m. Long-term: make playbook-runner honor a stability window.

maria_cs_ops: good. For immediate ops: can we suppress playbook executions for that time window and tag affected accounts?

playbook-runner-bot: suppression endpoint hit. suppression_id=supp-20260324-01. Paused runs for cohorts: new_accounts_48h, trial_starters_7d.

sam_sre: I called the suppression API: POST /internal/playbook/suppress { start_ts: 1826002600, end_ts: 1826004400, tags: ["onboard","auto-nudge"], meta: "consumer-lag-duplicate-events" }

devon_cs: tagging accounts with suppress_auto_nudge now so future automation skips them. Will draft outreach acknowledging accidental nudges and offer quick help.

anya_data: PR opened to cs-scoring: add state_ttl debounce param default=10m + unit tests. https://git.internal/redwood/cs-scoring/pulls/129

product_lucas: also please add an operational guard: if event source lag > 30k for >10m, route playbook-runner into soft-fail mode (dry-run) until human clears.

sam_sre: added an alert and runbook: page oncall if cs-onboard-consumer lag > 30k msgs for >10m and auto-suppress new playbook runs.

maria_cs_ops: next steps: anya monitors PR and deploy, lucas updates playbook policy, devon coordinates outreach, sam keeps alerting and adds a postmortem note. No broad backfills until debounce and tags are in place. I'll post a short incident summary after CSV is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
